messages.author: 0422320eed3d541d
messages.subject: Re: Error in X.p[which(!is.na(y)), , drop = FALSE] : subscript out of bounds
parts: Nevermind, I fixed my issue. I looked into my datafile and saw that some detection covariates got shifted in data entry resulting in a survey where detection data was present for a survey that did not occur. After correcting this, the model ran. Leaving this post up just in case anyone in the future runs into the same problem.
